I really like the product. The idea is great and it’s really good when you have multiple oil changes to do one after the other. You don’t have to worry about emptying it every time like a normal drain pan thanks to the 15 gallon capacity. The pump works great, I empty the drain pan directly inside 5 gallon containers using the tube and I don’t make a mess on tye floor anymore thanks to the deep pan and mesh.
Works well, saves alot of mess! Easy to assemble good quality. Highly recommend!
